title: Typed API Layer
prompt:
Centralize fetch in one typed module so every call site has the same error handling and headers.

**Requirements:**
1. In `apiClient.ts`, define and export `class ApiError extends Error { constructor(public status: number, message: string) { super(message); } }`.
2. Export `async function apiGet<T>(url: string): Promise<T>`:
   - `const r = await fetch(url, { headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' } });`
   - `if (!r.ok) throw new ApiError(r.status, r.statusText);`
   - `return (await r.json()) as T;`
3. Export `async function apiPost<TReq, TRes>(url: string, body: TReq): Promise<TRes>` that POSTs `JSON.stringify(body)` and returns the parsed response (same error handling).
hints: Centralizing here means auth headers, base URL, error handling, and tracing all live in one place.
`<T>` lets each call site pin the response shape without repeating cast logic.
A typed `ApiError` makes catch blocks easier -- check `instanceof ApiError` then read `status`.
